SessionStart.command: bash -c 'while [ ! -f scripts/agent-log.mjs ] && [ "$PWD" != / ]; do cd ..; done; [ ! -f scripts/agent-log.mjs ] || node scripts/agent-log.mjs check --event SessionStart --format antigravity'

PreInvocation.command: bash -c 'while [ ! -f scripts/agent-log.mjs ] && [ "$PWD" != / ]; do cd ..; done; [ ! -f scripts/agent-log.mjs ] || node scripts/agent-log.mjs check --event PreInvocation --format antigravity --every 60'
